avis.texte: Im on my second bottle, i love this product, it cleared my skin so quickly without irritating my skin It does irritate the eyes but if you stay away from the eyes all is well
Perfect scrub to wash all away. Gentle yet does the job. Could use daily. Have not found anything I like better.
After 5 years, I will no longer be buying this product. The old formula did the job and this new one is just not doing it.. Also, it's 2026 and Origins is still testing on animals?!?
I love the freshness i get with using this cleanser without any dryness. The soapy suds really makes my skin happy for the day.

avis.auteur: Bring Back Never A Dull Moment
avis.titre: Disappointed. Nothing like me discontinued favourites
avis.texte: Hardly a 'scrub', more a mild cleanser. Bring back Never A Dull Moment and Modern Friction. Those WERE scrubs. Both of my discontinued favourites left my skin polished, exfoliated and clean, without drying my skin. Don't fix what isn't broken. This Ginzing cleanser pales in comparison. Totally outmatched and outclassed by NADM and MF. You have lost a loyal customer. I have been using those products for decades. Only to find it has been repalced with this weak, thin consistency, barely exfoliating cleanser, that contains plastic beads ewww. Gone is the lusciously thick, effectively exfoliating formula infused with papaya enzymes found in Never A Dull Moment. That stuff would last a whole year because a little would go a long-long way. It was of superior quality and therefore good value. I have yet to find anything quite as good for my skin as NADM or Modern Friction. I am so disappointed and underwhelmed by this Ginzing offering.
I love this gentle and effective exfoliater. It breaks trend and smooths the skin. Great price. I use almost daily with warm water and it keeps my skin smooth

I have been using this product for about a week and nothing has made an immediate impact on my skin so quickly. It looks so smooth and clear. I honestly look brighter and more youthful. I picked this up on a whim and had zero expectations. A product doesn't need to be abrasive to exfoliate your skin and a little goes a long way. I have combination/oily skin and find my skin less oily during the day.

This is my "go to" every time I shower. Since I am in the shower, all wet. I apply this to face, back of hands, and neck. It feels so good, like removing old skin and "dirt".... The smell is refreshing and overall, not too gritty. I have been using this product for YEARS!

My mother in law received a sample of this from the Estee Lauder company and gave it to me. I loved it and bought it! I have oily combination skin and Ive been having some bunpy texture problems too. This scrub gets everything though and it leaves my skin feels like brand new. Although I would say it is a tad too coarse for my liking, but ill still use it cause its great. I wouldn't recommend for sensitive/dry skin.
This made me have a severe reaction. Would NOT recommend for sensitive and /or acne prone skin.
love this scrub! it's not too extreme nor mild for exfoliation, the foaming doesn't leave my skin feeling dry/stripped, and it smells great
This is my favorite product. I use it last when I shower and enjoy the fresh scent and feel. It makes me happy.

This falls very short as a replacement for modern friction. I'm a bald dude and MF was the best scrub and polish for my winter dry skin. I will look elsewhere for a product that works. Is there any chance modern friction gets revived?

I was excited to try this, but I would barely call this a scrub….. to even feel any sort of scrub-like effect, you need a ton, and still it's just not quite a scrub. If you have super extra sensitive skin, this is probably great- but I can handle an actual scrub, and this was disappointing
Bought as replacement for Modern Friction. Didn't work. Yuck.
My skin is sensitive and dry however I still need a good facial scrub. I absolutely love this product, it leaves my skin feeling soft and supple. Highly recommend.
I use origin moisturizers and love those. Decided to try their ginseng facial scrub. I love the scent and the small beads aren't too abrasive on my face. Two thumbs up! 👍
Saw this on sale when in the store and decided to try it. I like it, it's not too abrasive and leaves my face feeling good.

avis.auteur: Soon to be former Origins Fan
avis.texte: Used it previously (maybe sample size or part of a gift set) and loved it. The 2 tubes i bought last year and finally got around to using it (stored in cool place always). Found it not exfoliating at all. The scrubbing beads were far and few and it just felt "slippery". Have ti use in conjunction with a facial washing cloth/Clarisonic brush. Sad that Modern Friction has been discontinued, and also Perfect World Toner! I usually stock up when there is a good sale and just only realize many fav oldies are gone!
This is a lovely scented and fresh scrub. My skin is fmvery smooth after use. I'll definitely keep buying and using this cleanser. I hope it doesn't become discontinued.

I love this cleanser. It smells amazing, the little balls dissolve instantly and the cleanser feels so smooth on my skin. A little does go along way. I also use this to remove my make up and it works amazing. Definitely recommend this profuct.

I bought as a substitute for Modern Friction - which I loved & wish Origins would bring back. I have been happy with other Ginzing products, but this did not work for me. My face did not feel much different after using & I broke out for the first time in forever. Like other Ginzing products, I do like the smell. Hoping I can get a refund.

avis.titre: Product smells great but would not buy again
avis.texte: The product smells great however it was not to my expectations nor my husband's. I we are looking for one that is more exfoliating. This one is too soft for our taste and moved minimal of the dead skin. This is more for my husband but i gave it a try to rate it.
Super gentle and smells amazing. Using this one twice a week. Work great for my dry and sensitive skin.
I use Origins face cleanser products regularly. I recently ran out, so I grabbed another brand at a drugstore. Mistake! I hurried back to Ulta for my favorite. (My skin thanked me.)

My husband bought this a long time ago from a sale and never used it. I was curious since he told me his acne cannot be controlled with it. i however have pretty fair skin and rare breakouts. I decided to try it out and also using my vibrating facial scrub thing and my skin definitely feels soft! I used mosterizer after but wow! Love it 🤓💕

I've purchased and repurchased many a time. Never fails me. I love that the exfoliating beads are not abrasive and leave your skin feeling raw. Super gentle physical exfoliation. Only thing i dislike is that the scent is pretty strong, not unpleasent, just strong.

It really does its job and cleanses very well, however I do have a problem with the size and the applicator! I wish there was a way to use it without using so much formula. Leaves skin soft but kinda smells different. Gifted by Origins Us!

avis.titre: I do buy this product often
avis.texte: I love this product!!! My face feels so soft and clean after using.
I use this stuff as my almost-daily face wash and one bottle lasted over a year for me. A little goes a long way.

avis.titre: I like it, but not my daughter (allergic reaction)
avis.texte: I recently purchased this exfoliant and have been happy with using it. I had my 13 year old daughter use it tonight, and this was the outcome. I tried to put some of the same collection moisturizer on her face, barely put a drop on, and she said it burned. Not sure what ingredient is causing this reaction, but she definitely can't use this line of Origins products, and she knows how good other Origins is.
Perfect for when you wake up in the morning and you need a refreshing and revitalizing feel! It smells like oranges and it's the perfect amount of exfoliation daily
Love this moisturizer, it feels good on my skin. And, smells good.
I bought this because I wanted an exfoliating scrub without chemicals. This smells amazing and a little bit goes a long way.

avis.titre: Got a trial, will buy full size
avis.texte: I was interested in finding an exfoliator and got a trial size tube of this scrub. First of all, love the clean citrus scent! I like the cooling gel texture too. I like that it foams up as well as exfoliates, but it has not dried out my skin like Checks & Balances does. I use it once a week to cleanse and slough off flaky skin, since I have combination skin with an oily T-Zone that can get dry in some spots. Keeps oil under control. I am prone to breakouts, but this does not make me break out. Makes my skin feel balanced and never dry/stripped.

avis.titre: I have bought this again and again!
avis.texte: I use this in the shower a few times a week. It is not too harsh, just the right amount of exfoliation and the fresh citrus scent is not too strong. My husband keeps stealing it, which is not great as this is a bit pricy.

I absolutely love this. Got it in a kit when I bought a bunch of Origins stuff. I honestly didn't expect to like it. Yet it doesn't have enough texture to really be a scrub so it's safe to use with my Foreo! A tiny bit with the Foreo mini and it's Spa Time. It plays nicely with oils, balms, and oily scrubs. So it's great in my two step cleansing routine. It's highly concentrated/foamy so I use only a little bit to avoid stripping my skin biome. A very nice surprise winner.
I know this is a cleanser and not a make up remover. However, I've used cleansers before that would take care of make-up build up. This one didn't. Will probably not buy again.
It smells good lov the way it feels on my face. The package is a pretty orange. Yes I do tell my family and friends and I give out as gifts.

As a 50ish couple we both enjoy this product. A dime size is all you need to wake up your skin in the morning. Feels fresh, revitalized, and clean. I follow with toner, serum, and moisturizer. Evening I use antiaging Origins cleanser followed with toner, serum and moisturizer.
This product makes my face feel super clean and refreshed. It is a bit drying but with a good moisturizer after it's good. It did make my skin brighter.

I cant live without using this once a day in the shower! I scrub scrub all over face and neck with the wonderful delicious smell of fresh orange peel. i love this product and i use the GinZing Gel moisturizer in the mornings

I use this scrub first thing in the morning and boy does it make a huge difference on how "awake" my skin feels! My sister has sensitive skin and she really likes it too. Don't need a whole lot, I use smaller than a dime every application.

Loved it!!! Buying it my third time!!! It's gentle and smells delicious. It's a gel consistency with small beads that I love. It's gentle on sensitive skin and a small amount goes a long way. Loved it!!! Would recommend it for all skin types. Feel squeaky clean and fresh after a use. Does not dry up skin. Perfect!
Great face scrub, non irritating. Makes my face feel super smooth!
I use it as a face wash and it really revitalizes my skin. I got a sample of it and I bought the full size.

I use this cleanser every morning and I love it. It exfoliates so so gently. I never have to worry about it being to harsh. It smells amazing. Creates the most amazing lather. After rinsing my skin feels so awake and bright. I feel so energized and ready to start the day
I really do love this exfoliator/scrub. It leaves my skin so soft and is not too harsh in the face. I only use it 3/5 times a week as my exfoliator and it works great for my skin.
I've used many cleansers in my time. This is the best one I've ever used. My skin feels clean, bright and never dried out. I love the way this product feels and smells. It makes my day!
I purchased one of the best seller sets which included the Ginzing and it is wonderful. I am seeing a remarkable difference in my skin. I am ordering products for family members as gifts.
It's extremely gentle, it doesn't feel like it's exfoliating. Also, it creates to much foam, feels like a soap at times. My skin doesn't look of feel any different after using this product.

avis.titre: A staple in my skincare routine ♥️
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin , especially as I'm getting older (47) can't use highly fragrances products etc.. this has helped calm my redness and my skin is so soft afterwards. Because of the great ingredients with natural oils, it lathers really great so you don't need much at all for your face and neck. At 5 oz , you really get your money's worth. It's a keeper, love it 🥰
Don't feel like it exfoliate enough and makes my face very dry after

Wow. I am impressed with this scrubbing cleanser. Feels good and smells good. Made my face feel like I took a long shower or bath and it was just a quick shower after work. It is refreshing. I will continue to buy

I love this exfoliate because it doesn't ever over-exfoliate your skin where you feel scratched and it's safe for everyday use! But I still feel fresh and clean! I send this to everybody who needs new face wash!! I always pair it with the sets they come in !

I was looking for a morning face wash that would lightly exfoliate. This does just what I need. Works well and smells good. I did see some other reviews mention price but I do think a little goes a long way so it will last a long time.

This scrub cleanser truly gets all the dry and skin off your face and cleanses your face like no other. I do not use it often considering it is a serious exfoliate and this 5 oz bottle lasts me FOREVER.

This is my new favorite cleanser. The scrub is gentle and leaves my face feeling so clean but not overly dry and it smells great. I use this followed by the Ginzing serum and ultra hydrating moisturizer and my skin is clear, soft, and glows!

Super gentle. I'm able to use it more often than a more abrasive one so it doesn't rip my face off. I love the ginzing products because the smell is so so good. If you're looking for a daily exfoliator, this is a perfect one. Save the harsher, more abrasive or chemical ones for a weekly use.

I did not feel compelled to leave a review until reading all of the negatives. I purchased this in a discounted Christmas gift set without any prior expectations. I had been struggling all year with horrible breakouts and this line of products cleared my skin! I use the Ginzing cleanser, moisturizer, and brightening serum daily. I have had sensitive skin my whole life and recommend this product!

I've been using Origins for 5+ years and use most products from the Ginzing line daily. I normally use the Cheeks & Balances face wash but decided to try the Ginzing cleanser on my most recent purchase. I DO NOT recommend for sensitive skin. My entire face is broken out, patchy, and dry (I never have acne). This is the only new facial product I've used in months.
I love this! Even though it is a bit pricy i don't even have to use a lot of product and works great for people with underhydrated skin! So impressed 😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃😃
I read some of the reviews and people were complaining about the beads in the face wash. I personally like them I like how it exfoliates my face without ripping it off.
This product is very refreshing and energizing with an amazing citrus smell. Perfect for year round use.

Gentle face wash that has enough foam and small scrubbing pieces for a gentle exfoliation. Can easily rub eyes with no irritation. Still can be used daily and a little goes a long way so this will last you forever.
I have repurchased this more than 3 times. Very gentle on the skin. A little goes along way.

The only bad thing about it, it leaves a nasty taste if i get it to close to my lips and gets in my mouth but besides that i love the way it makes my skin feel! Im still trying to get use to the moisturizer not use to that tingly sensation feeling but i have very sensitive skin and i have not broke out from it yet.

I use this in the shower or when washing my face in the sink (as its own cleanser/exfoliant, not as makeup remover). The jojoba beads are strong enough to exfoliate but soft enough for daily use. The citrus scent is refreshing but potentially overpowering if you're sensitive to scents.

I've been using this scrub for a couple of months and I love it! It smells great and it isn't too rough on my skin. I use this nightly before using my other serums and moisturizers, and it leaves my skin looking radiant and hydrated. This bottle is also huge! So a little goes a long way and it will last you a while. Definitely worth the money.
when I rinse my face the cleanser leaves a nasty chemical taste in my mouth no matter how I try to use and rinse.
I use this face scrub daily.I love the way it makes my skin feel.
I love this product. It smells great and feels clean and fresh. It has just the right amount of exfoliation for my dry skin. A little bit goes a long way and lathers well. I will use this again

avis.titre: Made me breakout - worst breakout I've had in years :(
avis.texte: So disappointed I am using this cleanser as well as the ginzing moisturiser and have completely broken out so bad I can't even hide it with foundation because my pimples are raised. It's the worst break out I have had in so long and it's going to take so long to repair my skin :( I love this brand and everything but it really doesn't work on my skin and worst of all I am sad I've spent so much money on products that have made my skin worse
I love the smell of this cleanser but did not love the results... Immediate break outs. Good lather with minimal exfoliating beads. Had to return unfortunately.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I use this product to wash my face twice a day! I had oily skin and other products I used before irritated my skin and I would get a lot of pimples and blackheads. My skin was glowing after the first wash! I have been using this product for two years now and my skin looks better than ever! No more red oily skin and no more acne!

I just love Origins Ginzing Refreshing Scrub Cleanser . I have sensitive skin and this cleanser doesn't harm my skin. It has the same light citrus scent the moisturizer has. My face feels so clean. I use this cleanser every morning. I feel like a little bit of this product goes a long way.I will definitely continue to purchase this product.

avis.titre: I'm buying this over and over again! :)
avis.texte: I've been using this product for 3 months now and just ordered more. I typically deal with pores and blackheads more often and I love the scrub actions it provides. Gives the extra cleansing experience and my skin is use to it. I didn't feel it was over drying at all. I use the origins toner afterwards and I just love it all. The smell is citrus awakening!

avis.titre: I would and will buy this again
avis.texte: I use this product after washing my face with my foaming face wash and it cleans my face really well and makes my skin smell good and feel fresh.

This face scrub is gentle and smells amazing. I don't like exfoliators that are super grainy and this one is the perfect balance of a light scrub that leaves my skin feeling refreshed but also a slight resurfacing of any dead skin. I have only been using it for a few weeks but I am already a big fan!
This is a great scrub. It's rich in application, producing abundant suds for deep cleaning. Love it.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: Love how a little goes a long way with this formula. I do wish there were more beads to exfoliate with.

Got the origins mini travel size kit for Christmas and fell in love with ever product in it! Ordered full size bottles so I can keep my skin fresh and hydrated. I'm oily and acne prone but seems to keep my face happy and calm!
I really like this. my skin was feeling dry and gross, and I used this once and my face feels so refreshed. I think it helped brighten and definitely helped soften the skin.

at first it worked great. My skin was smooth and it helped with blackheads. After 1 week of use I started to develop painful large cystic pimples. I dont know if it was a purging period but I didnt want to keep trying it to find out. I went back to cerve SA and the breakouts stopped.
this is perfect in the morning to wake up my skin like a shot of coffee for your face!
This is my favorite face wash! My face feels so clean and refreshed after I use it this! I will never buy another face wash other then this.

Product has a great scent and texture however it irritated my skin so badly after just one use. I have "normal" skin and regularly use exfoliating products but this one made my face extremely red and itchy

I'm really picky with exfoliated face washes, and this is amazing!! It doesn't feel like I'm stripping my face away when I do wash. Not to mention, my gf uses it as well! She doesn't usually wash her face much but when she does she always grabs this product and she loves it! A huge plus also, the smell is amazing!!

I'm very picky about cleansers so I was pleasantly surprised by this one. I bought this in a set of Origins products at Christmas and I love the way it makes my skin feels! It deeply cleanses without stripping or overdrying my skin. Leaves my face with a soft, dewy glow! I have found my go-to cleanser as well as my go-to skin care brand! I will continue to purchase and I highly recommend this product and this brand!

I wanted to give this a try because I really love Origins but this didn't exfoliate my skin at all. It barely had any texture to it and it left my skin not feeling any different than what it was before I washed. I will unfortunately be returning this product and go back to what I usually use.

I like a deeper scrub, one where I feel like I am sloughing away all the dried skin. However, it was suggested by my dermatologist to get a more gentle scrub and this Origins scrub was recommended. I do feel that the product does not strip my skin of natural oils nor does it have too much perfume in it. It is a simple and gentle scrub with a soft scent. Origins is a solid brand and I feel the price point is good for the quality of the product.

I love this product! Anytime I am wearing heavy makeup or feel the need to deep clean my face, this is my go to! The scent is citrus and I absolutely love it. I feel that it wakes me up in the morning. It's an amazing product making my skin feel fresh and clean!

I love the Ginzing scrub cleanser. I just started using it this past month but it smells lovely and makes my skin feel refreshed and smooth. I cleanse my skin with this scrub cleanser in the morning (or the Checks & Balances cleanser) and then use the Ginzing SPF40 moisturizer. I have very sensitive, pale, dry/oily combination skin and have not experienced any irritation or sensitivity from this product.

Probably the worst cleanser I have used from Origins, I am a long time fan of the frothy face and decided to try this line. It leaves my face extremely dry and I have developed tiny little bumps on my face from it. I wouldn't recommended this product to anyone who has sensitive skin. Stick to the frothy face
I use this favorite to wash my face in the morning and evening, before applying day/night cream. The smell is awesome and just a tiny bit goes a long way.

I got this scrub as a gift, and it is so amazing! It cleared up my skin within a few days. I've been using it every two days for the past six months and it just ran out, so it's definitely a good investment! The only minor issue is that if you use it in the shower with hot water, it can dry out your skin, but it's nothing that a little moisturizer can't fix!

avis.titre: The best scrub I have ever used
avis.texte: This is so gentle! It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin and it does help with gentle, gentle exfoliation to deal with the peely spots that I get. The scent is fantastic, refreshing, and not overwhelming.
Smells amazing, really grainy beads which I enjoy, foams and cleanses nicely. However, I recently discovered that Neutogenas invigorating face scrub does EXACTLY THE SAME THING.
Very refreshing. Leaves my skin feeling very clean and soft. Recommend highly. Will keep purchasing this cleanser.

avis.titre: First step of my daily routine
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this cleanser, only small amount of it is enough to clean and scrub all your face, removes any dirt as gently as possible without over-drying the skin, the smell is soft and refreshing and it gives a nice bright feeling in the mornings, I have a sensitive combination skin but this one did not irritate my skin although I was worried it will

This is a great cleanser, it really wakes my skin up. I would consider this an exfoliator, because there is just not a lot of scrubby grains. This would be perfect for daily use in the mornings. My skin feels refreshed, and soft after use. Smell is great too!
I loved the moisturizer so was excited to try the scrub. So disappointed that it caused my skin to breakout. Skin is worse after using this.
My husband swears this helps prevent him from breaking out. I've bought it for him for the 3rd time now.

avis.titre: My skin feels and looks clean
avis.texte: My teens use it as well as myself, we love the way our skin feels after use. I can see and feel buildup on my skin if I miss a few days
i use this mask after cleansing my face and honestly it really can give your face a glowy, dewy look without having to put on any makeup :) would recommend to those who like a natural, dewy look

This is a good cleanser. I've have combo skin that is sensitive to change. This cleanser doesn't make me break out and cleans my skin. It is not, however, a scrub. It's gentle, it cleans my make-up off, it's perfect for oily and dry. BUT it isn't a scrub.

avis.titre: ORIGINS: Instructions on how to use please!!
avis.texte: Instrucions on how to use please!!! I just bought this product yesterday. There is no instructions either on website or on the product! Please advise! I love Origins and always do. But i am confused on how to use your product sometimes. Is this product a regular exfoliator that i should use it 1-2 times a week after i wash my face with my regular cleanser OR I should use this product everyday as my regular face cleanser (So i don't have to use my face cleanser but use this one instead of my face cleanser?) I am confused since it says "scrub cleanser."

So disappointing- it leaves a weird soapy film on my skin and doesn't remove makeup or oil at all. I have normal to slightly sensitive skin and didn't seem to exfoliate at all. It's a bummer because I love Origins products.

avis.titre: An excellent face wash to keep in rotation
avis.texte: Ginzing scrub cleanser is perfect for summer. It handles tougher sunscreen grime and sweat without drying out my skin.

I use this every night in the shower and the perfect world antioxidant cleanser with white tea in the morning. It smells amazing, and leave my skin so soft after the shower. My husband never used to wash his face until he used this exfoliant for the first time and loves the sent, he uses it every night! The bottle has last so long, even with two people using it! We love it!

I needed something to get rid of the dry skin in the creases of my nose but not too harsh for the rest of my face. Thus product did the job. It's not a super hard scrub. Left my skin feeling soft and it smells amazing!

I use this product at night time before masks and in the morning before i put on my lotions. It invigorates my skin in the morning for sure, makes it feel softer and brighter. At night time I use it on my neck mostly and sometimes bring it up to my face but I am trying to get rid of the lines on my neck and this is supposed to be a part of that process. It is not too aggressive at all which is wonderful and a little goes a long way.

I love this cleanser as a very gentle exfoliator! It isn't as "scrubby" as some of the others I've used, which is nice because it doesn't make my skin feel red or raw. It has a fabulous scent that totally wakes me up in the morning.
This product cleared my acne and brightened my complexion. It is just amazing!
